title: Button King on Throne
description: A stylized white-line drawing of a crowned demonic figure with a menacing expression sits atop a massive pile of colorful buttons. He holds a glowing ring in one hand and a scepter topped with clustered buttons in the other, set against a dark cosmic background with glowing orbs.
prompt: A demonic king with a spiked crown and sharp features drawn in glowing white lines sits on a towering mound of hundreds of colorful vintage buttons. He holds a luminous golden ring in one hand and a long scepter topped with a cluster of buttons in the other. Dark cosmic background with floating glowing orbs and subtle smoke, high contrast, surreal nightmare style.
medium: chalk or digital painting on black
